newsitem.title: JAPAN: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF WOMEN'S DOWNHILL WINNER.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF WOMEN'S DOWNHILL WINNER.

text.p: Following is a brief profile of the winner of a women's World Cup downhill on Friday:
World Cup wins: 3. Downhills - Narvik (96), Laax (97), Hakuba (97)

Other feats: Zelenskaya placed eighth in the downhill at the 1994 Lillehammer Olympics. She was the fifth-ranked World Cup downhiller last season and 17th overall. She began competing on the World Cup circuit at age 16.
